text: The EQC-led Enhancement of Volcanic Risk, Loss Modeling, and Policy is a comprehensive initiative aimed at modernizing volcanic risk forecasting, loss modeling, and operational policy in New Zealand. It integrates next-generation loss modeling, targeted volcano-science investments, and operational policy reforms to improve readiness for volcanic eruptions. The initiative involves collaboration with public and private organizations to enhance the Natural Disaster Response Model and streamline insurance operations.
